learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the rich cultural heritage of the traditional Indian 'Pankha' (hand fan) and how artisans are adapting to modern times to keep the craft alive!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The chapter highlights the history, regional variations, and intricate craftsmanship of the Indian hand fan. Once an everyday necessity to beat the heat, it carries deep cultural and artistic value.

With the invention of electric fans and air conditioners, the practical everyday use of Pankhas declined sharply. Today, their role has changed from being cooling tools to becoming decorative cultural objects.
To preserve this beautiful heritage, artisans are blending traditional making skills with innovative, modern designs. This mix helps attract new, modern buyers while keeping the ancient craft alive.

Initiatives like Pankha-making workshops and cultural exhibitions are being held. These spread awareness, teach the younger generation the necessary skills, and provide better income opportunities for the artisans.

fun_activity.title: 🪭 DIY Pankha
fun_activity.instructions: Take a piece of colorful paper, fold it back and forth in a tight zigzag pattern, pinch and tie the bottom with a string, and open the top like a peacock's tail. You just made a simple traditional paper fan!

exam_tips: 📌 Explain how the 'role' of the Pankha has changed in modern India (from practical cooling devices to decorative cultural artifacts).
📌 Mention two ways (workshops, blending modern designs) how the craft is being preserved and how it helps the artisans earn a living.
📌 Understand why preserving traditional materials and techniques protects a community's cultural heritage.
quick_recap: ⭐ The Pankha represents the diverse regional art forms of India.
⭐ Modern designs combined with traditional methods are the key to the survival of ancient crafts.
⭐ Exhibitions help artisans showcase their work directly to a larger audience, ensuring better financial returns.
